steps.text: Adolescence brings emotional changes too — feelings can be stronger and can shift quickly. Let's look at some situations.
Read each scenario and choose how you'd feel or respond, then move to the next one.
Mood swings are normal — the same day can bring excitement, worry, and irritation. That doesn't mean anything is wrong.
Healthy ways to cope: talk to someone you trust, take a break, be kind to yourself, and ask for help when you need it.

coach.mission: Explore emotional changes and healthy ways to handle them.
whenStuck: Read the scenario and pick a response, then tap “Next Scenario”.
Think about a calm, healthy way to handle the feeling.
whenWrong: Strong or changing emotions are normal in adolescence.
A healthy response is to talk it out or take a break — not to bottle it up.
whenCorrect: Right — that's a healthy way to handle the feeling.
Good — talking to someone you trust really helps.
coach.done: You've seen that mood changes are normal and can be handled in healthy ways. Move on when you're ready.
